vertically aligned ZnO/Tio2 (VA-ZO/Tio2) core-shell nanocomposites deposited on ZnOsseeded indium tin oxide glasses have been prepared by a chemical bath approach for growing one-dimension ZnO structure, followed by a spin coating for coating TiO on the surface of the ZnO structure.
the power conversion efficiency of DSSC based on VA-ZnO can be improved by coating TiO2 layer on ZnO surface.
the VA-Zn0/TiO2 core-shell composite electrode has been synthesized by a simple and effective approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of a new type of ZnO/Ti O 2 core/shell composites for dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs).
the development of a simple, efficient, and low-cost method for fabricating VA-ZnO-based photoelectrodes for DSSCs, which may be a promising approach to enhance the efficiency of DSSCs.
the preparation of a vertically aligned ZnO/TIO2 core-shell composites by a chemical bath method for dye sensitized solar cells.

the ZnO/Ti O2 core-shell composite with the appropriate thickness of the TiO2 shell layer is a promising photoanode material for DSSC applications.
the VA-Zn O/TiO2 composites with the optimized CSCT can be used as an effective electrode material for DSSC.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the VA-Zn-O/TiO2 composites can be prepared by a chemical bath approach and spin coating method.

the VA-Zn O/TiO2 core-shell composites can be used as photoanode in the fabrication of dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs), which exhibit higher power conversion efficiency than that of the pristine vertically aligned ZnO (VA-Zn O).
the VA-Zn0/TiO2 core-shell composite can be a good candidate for DSSCs with improved power conversion efficiency.
